title: Tech Note: Image Manipulation with GD
author: Tom Fitch, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: GD PHP image manipulation library (loading, drawing, text, color, conversion)
4D wrappers for GD functions with a sample database

historical_commentary.text: This PHP/GD-based image-manipulation bridge still technically works wherever 4D's PHP interpreter and a GD-enabled PHP build are available, but it is a legacy technique; 4D has since added native picture-manipulation commands directly in the 4D language (resizing, format conversion, drawing on pictures) that eliminate the need for a PHP/GD dependency for many common image tasks in modern 4D applications.
related_updates: Native 4D picture/image commands added in later 4D versions reduce the need for a PHP/GD bridge for common image manipulation tasks
